title: Finite-Dimensional Feedback Stabilization of Nonautonomous Stochastic Parabolic Equations
summary: We investigate finite-dimensional feedback stabilization for nonlinear nonautonomous stochastic parabolic equations driven by $Q$-Wiener, covering both additive and multiplicative perturbations. The control is given by a finite linear combination of localized indicator-type actuators whose supports are selected as part of the construction and may have arbitrarily small total measure. The feedback law is constructed by means of oblique projections onto suitable finite-dimensional subspaces. Within the variational Gelfand triple framework, we prove well-posedness of the closed-loop system…
